plan.title: Repeat Order Requires Old PO Reference

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's Master QCS with the two stated bids.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Allocate all 10 requested units on the first line to Vendor B.
Verify the complete line allocation and that one of the two bidding vendors is selected.
Open the proposal form for the allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Mark the proposal as a repeat order.
Attempt submission while leaving Old PO reference Number empty.
Assert that submission is refused because the required old PO reference is missing.
